snippet.title: Zeddytron on the ZX81. Gameplay of this new version of Robotron.
snippet.description:
Beta but very playable version of Robotron on the ZX81. Written by Walter Ariel Risi from Buenos Aires. 

No colour, no sound, no hires - coz that’s how it was.

Download from the ZX81 Owners Club Facebook group.
